Messages.Author: Tom, Mad & Co
Messages.Body:
I have tried lo track this down in google, and haven't found a proper
clarification.

With the new NRA rule, a given vamp is not able to repeat the same action
card twice each turn. It also forbids to take a political action twice in a
turn. Is this redundant, or a given vamp will not be able to call two
separate referendums given by different cards in a turn, e.g., a parity
shift and a KRC?

I guess the answer is no, a vamp can only call one political action each
turn, but needed to make it clear.

Tom, Mad&Co

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <ah691a$qta$1...@nsnmrro2-gest.nuria.telefonica-data.net>, "Tom,

Mad & Co" <t...@almadrava.net> writes:
>With the new NRA rule, a given vamp is not able to repeat the same action
>card twice each turn. It also forbids to take a political action twice in a
>turn. Is this redundant, or a given vamp will not be able to call two
>separate referendums given by different cards in a turn, e.g., a parity
>shift and a KRC?

The vampire cannot take more than one political action during the same
turn, regardless of whether it's a different vote, called with a card in
play, or called without using a card in play. (Like burning Archon,
since the card is never in play.)

Messages.Author: CurtAdams
Messages.Body:
LSJ cites:

>"A minion [...] cannot take a political action twice in a turn."

Actually this could be read as "only one KRC per turn, only
one Parity Shift per turn, etc." Better would be "a minion
may only perform on political action a turn".

Curt Adams (curt...@aol.com)
"It is better to be wrong than to be vague" - Freeman Dyson
